english.notes:
(i) Section 34(2) provides that disqualification under this subsection disqualifies a person from owning, keeping, participating in the keeping of, or being party to an arrangement under which he/she would be entitled to control or influence the way in which animals are kept.
(ii) Section 34(3) provides that disqualification under this subsection disqualifies a person from dealing in animals.
(iii) Section 34(4) provides that disqualification under this subsection disqualifies a person from transporting or arranging for the transportation of animals.
(iv) Section 34(5) provides that disqualification under subsection 34(2), 34(3) or 34(4) may be imposed in relation to animals generally, or in relation to animals of one or more kinds.
(v) Section 34(6) provides that the court by which an order under subsection 34(1) is made may specify a period during which the offender may not make an application under section 43(1) for termination of the order.
(vi) Section 34(7) provides that the court by which an order under subsection 34(1) is made may
(a) suspend the operation of the order pending an appeal, or
(b) where it appears to the court that the offender owns or keeps an animal to which the order applies, suspend the operation of the order, and of any order made under section 35 in connection with the disqualification, for such period as it thinks necessary for enabling alternative arrangements to be made in respect of the animal.
(vii) Section 34(8) provides that where a court decides not to make an order under subsection (1) in relation to an offender, it shall:-
(a) give its reasons for the decision in open court, and
(b) if it is a magistrates' court, cause them to be entered in the register of its proceedings.
